In Inazuma, Tatarigami means the corpse of a god and the odd phenomena it produces. Orobashi's lingering power became the Tatarigami on Yashiori Island, where it brings storms, lightning and corruption, and can drive people there mad. Crystal Marrow, which grows on his bones, carries a sliver of that power and strengthens metal when smelted into it.

The Shogunate later used it in the Mikage Furnace on Tatarasuna. In Orobashi's Legacy the Traveler helps the researcher Kaji restore ancient Narukami wards that held the Tatarigami back.

1.content: The weapon's text, from the Three Realms Gateway Offering event (limited), shows the serpent speaking to the child who asked him to become a god. He said that he fled because he could not beat Deus Auri or Narukami. He gave the child a jewel like a snake's eye to swear an oath on, saying he had used it to make pacts with his coral servants. Some of the people protest, citing Master Spartacus's teaching never to worship a god, and the serpent respects their will. Later, with the island complete and the vishaps repelled, he takes the remaining people to the surface, 'to fulfill his oath to the heavenly city'.

2.content: Ei killed Orobashi on Yashiori Island with Musou no Hitotachi, and the slash left the great rift of Musoujin Gorge. The war also took the lives of Mouun, Touzannou (Akuou) and Sasayuri. It is the root of the old bitterness between Narukami and Watatsumi.
